search.title: Search sensors
search.description:
Search by sensor code (e.g. `0101-001`, `T-050`, `2303LH`) or street. Climate and wind sensors are listed separately, nearest first.

With {selected_count} sensors: updates every **{interval} minutes**. The official API allows 30 requests per hour and every sensor needs one request per update, so {max_sensors} sensors fit a 10-minute interval. A station with temperature and wind counts as 2 sensors.

pick.title: Select sensors
pick.description:
{match_count} matches for "{query}". Pick individual sensors — climate (temperature, humidity, pressure, irradiation) and wind are separate sensors of the same station.

With {selected_count} sensors: updates every **{interval} minutes**. The official API allows 30 requests per hour and every sensor needs one request per update, so {max_sensors} sensors fit a 10-minute interval. A station with temperature and wind counts as 2 sensors.

too_many_sensors.title: Climate sensors only update every {interval} minutes
too_many_sensors.description:
You selected {count} climate sensors. The official Smart City Mannheim API allows 30 requests per hour, and every sensor needs one request per update. So values are fetched every {interval} minutes instead of every 10 minutes.

For 10-minute updates, select at most {max_sensors} sensors under Settings → Devices & services → Smart City Mannheim → Configure. Pollen, air quality and the DWD station are not affected.
